runtime: Local HTML or single-file offline.html. No build required at runtime.

coordinates.root: asset_root for authored props; collapsed v5 bind for guards

guards.bind: Retarget into the collapsed soccer-v5 bind; canonical local quaternions must be calibrated before use.

boars.rig: Four named rigid leg pivots, ground-compensated translation; anchors hit, ground, nose.

rendering.underLoad: DPR down to .75, contact shadows, matte Lambert without point lights/CSS blur, lowest LOD; finally DPR .5 if long frames persist. The delivered GLBs retain PBR materials.
rendering.paused: No repeated WebGL draws until the view changes. Pause and inspector controls restore up to DPR 1.5.
